# telnyx_10dlc_brand_sms_otp_trigger (Action)

Sends, or sends again, an SMS one-time password to the mobile phone of a sole proprietor 10DLC brand. Campaigns cannot be created for the brand until the password is verified.



<!-- action schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `brand_id` (String) The brand id.
- `pin_sms` (String) SMS message template to send the OTP. Must include `@OTP_PIN@` placeholder which will be replaced with the actual PIN
- `success_sms` (String) SMS message to send upon successful OTP verification
